question: What are the top 5 countries with the highest total invoice sales?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) as TotalSales FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find all customers who have made purchases totaling over $40.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName as CustomerName, SUM(i.Total) as TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING TotalSpent > 40 ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
gold_answer: Helena Holý ($49.62), Richard Cunningham ($47.62), Luis Rojas ($46.62), Ladislav Kovács ($45.62), Hugh O'Reilly ($45.62), Manny López ($40.62), Julia Barnett ($40.62)

question: Which 3 artists have the most total albums in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) as AlbumCount FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC LIMIT 3
gold_answer: Iron Maiden (21), Led Zeppelin (14), Deep Purple (11)

question: List the top 5 tracks with the longest duration in milliseconds.
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5
gold_answer: Occupation / Precipice (5286953), Through a Looking Glass (5088838), Battlespace (4995416), Harold (4804104), Greetings from Earth (4654924)

question: What is the total spending of customer Frank Harris?
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName as CustomerName, SUM(i.Total) as TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.FirstName = 'Frank' AND c.LastName = 'Harris' GROUP BY c.CustomerId

question: Find the total revenue generated in each month of the year 2021.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) as Month, SUM(Total) as TotalRevenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2021' GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month

question: Which employee supported the customer who spent the highest total amount?
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName as EmployeeName, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName as CustomerName, SUM(i.Total) as TotalSpent FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 1
gold_answer: Margaret Park (supported Helena Holý who spent $49.62)

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(t.TrackId) as UnpurchasedTracks FROM Track t LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId WHERE il.InvoiceLineId IS NULL

question: Find all genres that have more than 100 tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) as TrackCount FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name HAVING TrackCount > 100 ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
gold_answer: Rock (1297), Latin (579), Metal (374), Alternative & Punk (332), Jazz (130)

question: What is the total sales count for tracks by the artist Queen?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) as TotalQuantity, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) as TotalRevenue FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId WHERE ar.Name = 'Queen' GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
